paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada ruthlessly concealed his affection for Odai, never revealing the slightest trace of it even before his retainers. This was not only out of consideration for the Imagawa clan, but also meant as a display for Kariya.

paragraphs.source_en: “What are one or two women, after all?” Behind this childish bravado lay the grief he was striving to conceal. If Odai lost her composure amid the turmoil, all his painstaking efforts would be wasted. How Odai conducted herself at this moment would directly affect Takechiyo’s future. He wanted Odai to leave an impression of strength.

paragraphs.source_en: “Listen: no one is to cling to Her Ladyship and weep.” Uta-no-suke gave these instructions to Oda Wahei, a servant who was inspecting the cleaning.

paragraphs.source_en: Since being confined there, the young mother had not seen Takechiyo again. She had pleaded with Hirotada to let her see the child just once. In truth, there were many ways to arrange a meeting: Takechiyo’s nurse, O-Sada, need only bring him to visit Uta-no-suke’s wife. But Hirotada would not consent. He himself could cut through the bamboo fence and come to visit Odai. Yet if Odai were allowed to see Takechiyo again, confining her there would lose all meaning.

paragraphs.source_en: By the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Hare, people had begun arriving at the inner-court gate of Uta-no-suke’s residence. The women did not hide their faces, but the men all wore sedge hats pulled down over theirs.

paragraphs.source_en: The first man to arrive was Ōkubo Shinpachirō. Pushing through the women, he reached the bamboo fence and bent down to tighten the cords of his sandals; he meant to escort Odai. Next came the master of the house, Uta-no-suke, also wearing straw sandals. Seeing Shinpachirō’s attire, he could not help giving a faint smile.

paragraphs.source_en: Odai searched desperately among the women for the figure of Kayōin. The frailty of the bond between Takechiyo and herself was heartrending, and the partings and reunions between her and her own mother were equally painful to recall. Just as she was about to pass through the Sugō Gate, a shrill voice suddenly cried, “My lady of the upper chambers!” A woman came running toward her.

units.source_en: Now that Takechiyo had truly appeared before her, she could scarcely remain standing; even her bones seemed to stiffen and her blood to freeze…

ja.t: りついたかのようだった……

units.source_zh: 此刻竹千代当真出现在面前时，她却难以支撑了，甚至连骨头都僵硬了，血液都凝固了⋯⋯

paragraphs.source_zh: 从於大瞪大的双眼，可以看出她心潮澎湃。她已几乎停止了呼吸，眼神痴滞，身子纹丝不动。此刻竹千代当真出现在面前时，她却难以支撑了，甚至连骨头都僵硬了，血液都凝固了⋯⋯

paragraphs.source_en: Knowing Odai’s nature, she would never have taken this for O-Hisa’s revenge. She believed O-Hisa meant to tell her that she would care well for Takechiyo and see that the brothers joined their strength and lived in harmony.

units.source_en: Knowing Odai’s nature, she would never have taken this for O-Hisa’s revenge. She believed O-Hisa meant to tell her that she would care well for Takechiyo and see that the brothers joined their strength and lived in harmony.
units.source_zh: 依於大的性格，断不会以为这是阿久的报复，她认为阿久是想告诉她，会照顾好竹千代，让他们兄弟齐心协力，和睦相处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 依於大的性格，断不会以为这是阿久的报复，她认为阿久是想告诉她，会照顾好竹千代，让他们兄弟齐心协力，和睦相处。

paragraphs.source_en: “Suga, tell O-Hisa for me that I thank her for taking good care of my child.” Having said this to Suga, who had collapsed weeping at her feet, Odai walked toward the Sugō Gate.

units.source_en: “Suga, tell O-Hisa for me that I thank her for taking good care of my child.”

ja.t: にしてくれて、ありがとうと」

units.source_zh: “须贺，替我转告阿久，多谢她照顾好我的孩子。”

units.source_en: Having said this to Suga, who had collapsed weeping at her feet, Odai walked toward the Sugō Gate.
units.source_zh: 於大对哭倒在自己脚下的须贺说毕，便往菅生门走去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “须贺，替我转告阿久，多谢她照顾好我的孩子。”於大对哭倒在自己脚下的须贺说毕，便往菅生门走去。

paragraphs.source_en: The palanquin set out, and more than fifty people followed. Mizuno Shimotsuke-no-kami of Kariya and the Okazaki retainers had entirely opposite intentions. Shimotsuke-no-kami hoped to lure them into his domain and eliminate them all, while the Okazaki retainers hoped to deliver Odai secretly to Kariya and thereby ease his hostility toward Okazaki.

units.source_en: The palanquin set out, and more than fifty people followed.
units.source_zh: 轿子出发，有五十余人跟了上来。

units.source_en: Mizuno Shimotsuke-no-kami of Kariya and the Okazaki retainers had entirely opposite intentions.
units.source_zh: 刈谷的水野下野守和冈崎的家臣们想法正好相反。

units.source_en: Shimotsuke-no-kami hoped to lure them into his domain and eliminate them all, while the Okazaki retainers hoped to deliver Odai secretly to Kariya and thereby ease his hostility toward Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 下野守希望将他们引诱到自己的领地内悉数除掉，而冈崎的家臣却希望秘密地将於大送到刈谷，以化解下野守对冈崎的敌意。

paragraphs.source_zh: 轿子出发，有五十余人跟了上来。刈谷的水野下野守和冈崎的家臣们想法正好相反。下野守希望将他们引诱到自己的领地内悉数除掉，而冈崎的家臣却希望秘密地将於大送到刈谷，以化解下野守对冈崎的敌意。

paragraphs.source_en: After they had crossed the Yahagi River, Abe Sadatsugu said, “Shinpachi, just how far do you intend to escort her?”

units.source_en: After they had crossed the Yahagi River, Abe Sadatsugu said, “Shinpachi, just how far do you intend to escort her?”
units.source_zh: 过了矢矧川，阿部定次道：“新八，你到底打算送到哪里？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 过了矢矧川，阿部定次道：“新八，你到底打算送到哪里？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Isn’t it obvious? To the gates of Kariya Castle, of course.”

units.source_en: “Isn’t it obvious? To the gates of Kariya Castle, of course.”
units.source_zh: “这还用说，当然要送到刈谷城门。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这还用说，当然要送到刈谷城门。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Why escort her there?”

units.source_en: “Why escort her there?”
units.source_zh: “为何要送到那里？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “为何要送到那里？”

paragraphs.source_en: Beyond the Yahagi River, the colors of autumn deepened around them. In the fields stood green thickets of bamboo, interspersed with a few red lacquer trees, all simply awaiting winter’s arrival. Odai thought that in autumn, people too must conserve their strength and wait for winter and the coming year.

units.source_en: Beyond the Yahagi River, the colors of autumn deepened around them.
units.source_zh: 过了矢矧川之后，周围秋色渐浓。

units.source_en: In the fields stood green thickets of bamboo, interspersed with a few red lacquer trees, all simply awaiting winter’s arrival.
units.source_zh: 田中可以看见绿色的竹丛，间或有几株红色的山漆树，单等着冬天的到来。

units.source_en: Odai thought that in autumn, people too must conserve their strength and wait for winter and the coming year.
units.source_zh: 於大想，人在秋天必须养精蓄锐，等待冬天和来年。

paragraphs.source_zh: 过了矢矧川之后，周围秋色渐浓。田中可以看见绿色的竹丛，间或有几株红色的山漆树，单等着冬天的到来。於大想，人在秋天必须养精蓄锐，等待冬天和来年。

paragraphs.source_en: “Stop the palanquin.” Seeing Anshō Castle, over which the Oda and Matsudaira clans had fought and bled, Odai said softly from inside the palanquin, “I shall get down here.”

units.source_en: “Stop the palanquin.”
units.source_zh: “停轿。”

units.source_en: Seeing Anshō Castle, over which the Oda and Matsudaira clans had fought and bled, Odai said softly from inside the palanquin, “I shall get down here.”
units.source_zh: 於大看见织田和松平两家为之浴血奋战的安祥城，在轿中轻声说道，“我要下去。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “停轿。”於大看见织田和松平两家为之浴血奋战的安祥城，在轿中轻声说道，“我要下去。”

paragraphs.source_en: Abe Sadatsugu and Kaneda Masasuke looked around at the others in surprise. “No. The lord ordered us to escort Your Ladyship to Kariya Castle. That is our duty.” Ōkubo Shinpachirō spoke loudly.

units.source_en: Abe Sadatsugu and Kaneda Masasuke looked around at the others in surprise.
units.source_zh: 阿部定次和金田正佑惊讶地看了看众人。

units.source_en: “No. The lord ordered us to escort Your Ladyship to Kariya Castle. That is our duty.”

ja.t: じられております。それが

units.source_zh: “不行，城主吩咐过，将夫人送到刈谷城是我们的职责。”

units.source_en: Ōkubo Shinpachirō spoke loudly.
units.source_zh: 大久保新八郎大声道。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿部定次和金田正佑惊讶地看了看众人。“不行，城主吩咐过，将夫人送到刈谷城是我们的职责。”大久保新八郎大声道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Should any misfortune befall Your Ladyship, not only could we not answer to our lord, but we would also have failed the lord of Kariya. How can Your Ladyship say such a thing?” Sakai Uta-no-suke, wearing a sedge hat, reproached her. He must have recalled the danger surrounding Odai when she first came as a bride, for his tone was that of a father scolding his own daughter.

units.source_en: “Should any misfortune befall Your Ladyship, not only could we not answer to our lord, but we would also have failed the lord of Kariya.
units.source_zh: “夫人万一有不测，我们不仅无法向城主交待，也对不起刈谷的城主。

units.source_en: How can Your Ladyship say such a thing?”

ja.t: が、なぜそのようなことをおっしゃるのです？」

units.source_zh: 夫人怎会说出这种话来？”

units.source_en: Sakai Uta-no-suke, wearing a sedge hat, reproached her.
units.source_zh: 戴着斗笠的酒井雅乐助责备道。

units.source_en: He must have recalled the danger surrounding Odai when she first came as a bride, for his tone was that of a father scolding his own daughter.
units.source_zh: 他肯定想起了於大当年出嫁时的危险状况，语调就像在责备自己的女儿。

paragraphs.source_zh: “夫人万一有不测，我们不仅无法向城主交待，也对不起刈谷的城主。夫人怎会说出这种话来？”戴着斗笠的酒井雅乐助责备道。他肯定想起了於大当年出嫁时的危险状况，语调就像在责备自己的女儿。

paragraphs.source_en: “It is precisely because Your Ladyship is the mother of Lord Takechiyo that we fear anything might happen to you. Please do not stand on ceremony with us.” Abe Sadatsugu sounded somewhat aggrieved.

units.source_en: “It is precisely because Your Ladyship is the mother of Lord Takechiyo that we fear anything might happen to you.

ja.t: のことがあってはならぬと

units.source_zh: “正因为夫人是竹千代公子的生母，我们才怕有什么闪失。

units.source_en: Please do not stand on ceremony with us.”
units.source_zh: 夫人不用客气。”

units.source_en: Abe Sadatsugu sounded somewhat aggrieved.
units.source_zh: 阿部定次有些不服。

paragraphs.source_zh: “正因为夫人是竹千代公子的生母，我们才怕有什么闪失。夫人不用客气。”阿部定次有些不服。

paragraphs.source_en: All around them, the sound of men weeping suddenly arose; every one of them trembled with sobs.

units.source_en: All around them, the sound of men weeping suddenly arose; every one of them trembled with sobs.
units.source_zh: 周围顿时响起男人的哭泣声，每个人都在颤抖着抽泣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 周围顿时响起男人的哭泣声，每个人都在颤抖着抽泣。

paragraphs.source_en: Odai’s palanquin was entrusted to the villagers Abe Sadatsugu had found. At Odai’s urging, the Okazaki retainers reluctantly turned back, their figures fading from sight. Odai ordered the bearers to lift the palanquin. Loneliness swept through her entire being, and the sound of her quiet sobbing came from within the palanquin.

units.source_en: Odai’s palanquin was entrusted to the villagers Abe Sadatsugu had found.
units.source_zh: 於大的轿子被托付给阿部定次找来的百姓。

units.source_en: At Odai’s urging, the Okazaki retainers reluctantly turned back, their figures fading from sight.
units.source_zh: 冈崎的家臣们在於大的催促下，依依不舍地回转，身影消失在视线之外。

units.source_en: Odai ordered the bearers to lift the palanquin.
units.source_zh: 於大命人起轿。

units.source_en: Loneliness swept through her entire being, and the sound of her quiet sobbing came from within the palanquin.
units.source_zh: 孤独袭遍全身，轿内传出她的低声啜泣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 於大的轿子被托付给阿部定次找来的百姓。冈崎的家臣们在於大的催促下，依依不舍地回转，身影消失在视线之外。於大命人起轿。孤独袭遍全身，轿内传出她的低声啜泣。

paragraphs.source_en: Odai’s elder sister O-Sen, wife of Matsudaira Kii-no-kami Iehira, never imagined that all sixteen men who had come to see Odai off would perish beneath the blades of men sent by Shimotsuke-no-kami. All this happened beneath the cloudless sky of a day in the thirteenth year of Tenbun…

units.source_en: Odai’s elder sister O-Sen, wife of Matsudaira Kii-no-kami Iehira, never imagined that all sixteen men who had come to see Odai off would perish beneath the blades of men sent by Shimotsuke-no-kami.
units.source_zh: 於大的姐姐——松平纪伊守家广的夫人於仙实未料到，为她送行的十六人悉数死于下野守所派之人刀下。

units.source_en: All this happened beneath the cloudless sky of a day in the thirteenth year of Tenbun…
units.source_zh: 这一切就发生在天文十三年晴空万里的日子⋯⋯

paragraphs.source_zh: 於大的姐姐——松平纪伊守家广的夫人於仙实未料到，为她送行的十六人悉数死于下野守所派之人刀下。这一切就发生在天文十三年晴空万里的日子⋯⋯
